summary: Tested all 9 growth/viral features for the Financial Advisory Pro app. Backend: 9/9 growth endpoint tests passed. Frontend: 8/8 feature tests passed. All new features working correctly end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: DataCloneError in emergent-main.js ('Failed to fetch subscription: Request object could not be cloned') appears on every page load. This is a non-blocking console error from Emergent infrastructure, not app code.

TaxCalculatorUS FICA tab still shows old SS wage base description text '6.2% on income up to $168,600' in the FICA tab (line 518) but uses correct $176,100 in calculations. Text label should be updated to $176,100 for consistency.
PublicToolsPage: Header shows 'R ZAR' currency selector and SA jurisdiction flag even on the public /tools page (no login). Minor UX concern since /tools is US-focused.
seed_data_creation: Created test leads via /api/growth/capture-lead: TEST_lead_* emails, test_growthfeature@example.com, test_tools_capture@example.com. Created test referral codes via /api/growth/referral for TEST_user_* user_ids.

Frontend routes: /tools (public, no auth), /us/tax-comparison-2025 (ProtectedRoute only), /us/fi-score (ProtectedRoute only), all others are ProtectedRoute + GatedCalculator (Premium). Referral Widget appears on Dashboard at line 784 in Dashboard.jsx. Minor: TaxCalculatorUS FICA tab description still mentions old $168,600 SS wage base (code is correct at $176,100).
